questions.q: Where do you start building a brand-new report?
options: The Dashboards tab
The Reports tab, with New Report
Setup > Object Manager
The Report Builder's Filters tab
questions.explain: New reports start from the Reports tab. Clicking New Report is what first prompts you to choose a report type.

questions.q: In the Report Builder, what does the Fields pane show?
options: Only fields you have already added as columns
Every filter currently applied to the report
Every field the chosen report type exposes
A list of other reports in the same folder
questions.explain: The Fields pane lists every field available under the report's type, organized by object, ready to drag into the Outline.

questions.q: Why does the preview pane show only some records while you're building a report?
options: Because the report type restricts how many records exist
Because filters haven't been applied yet
Because the org has hit its storage limit
To keep the builder responsive while you edit
questions.explain: The live preview is intentionally limited to a subset of records so the builder stays fast while you drag fields and adjust settings. It is not the full result set.

questions.q: What's the difference between Save and Save & Run?
options: Save stores changes only; Save & Run also executes the report against the full data set
Save & Run only works on Matrix reports
Save deletes the draft; Save & Run keeps it
They are identical buttons with different labels
questions.explain: Save stores your edits without leaving the builder. Save & Run (or Run) executes the report against the complete data set, replacing the limited preview with real results.

questions.q: A new report has just been run for the first time. Which footer option would hide individual records and show only subtotal rows?
options: Grand Total
Row Counts
Detail Rows turned off
Stacked Summaries turned off
questions.explain: Turning off Detail Rows hides the individual record rows, leaving only group subtotals (and the grand total, if enabled) visible.
